nuovaDomanda.corpo: The current story ends: you start again from the first night with an empty Notebook. Records, unlocked modes and Laces of the day stay.

titolo.storiaAssente: The story is not ready in this version yet.

ricominciaDomanda.corpo: The hours you fixed come undone and the lace starts again from the opening. Pinned requests stay.
ricominciaDomanda.corpoSpartito: The score is woven again from the start.

impostazioni.contrastoDesc: Darker velvet, brighter text, outlined threads.
impostazioni.movimentoDesc: No swinging, no flying beads: things simply appear.
impostazioni.hapticsDesc: A light tap on crossings and refusals.
impostazioni.captionsDesc: Captions at the bottom left for bells, voices and noises.
impostazioni.autoAdvanceDesc: Dawn vignettes move on by themselves.
impostazioni.salvatoSempre: The game saves by itself every time you fix an hour. Here you can carry your progress to another device.
impostazioni.esportato: Save copied. Paste it wherever you want to keep it.
impostazioni.esportatoNonCopiato: Here is the save: select it and copy it.

importaDomanda.corpo: Your current progress becomes the one in the pasted save.

cancellaDomanda1.corpo: You lose the story, the Notebook, your records and your Laces of the day.

cancellaDomanda2.corpo: There is no going back. If you want a copy, export the save first.

impostazioni.cancellato: Everything erased. The pillow is empty.

fuso.etichetta: Ada's bobbin on the title screen and the linen bobbins
fuso.desc: Earned with golden threads and the Lace of the Day. They only change the look.

voce.testo: A rumour copies both ways: after the crossing both of them know it.

segreto.testo: A secret passes only from the thread on top to the one below. Whoever confides it, keeps it.

molo.testo: At boat time whoever is in the edge column leaves the lace, and whoever arrives takes their place.

febbre.testo: If one of the two is ill, after the crossing both are. The pharmacist, when he is on top, heals.

rancore.testo: Two threads holding a grudge give each other nothing when they cross: they knot, and stay still the next hour.

marea.testo: During high water the threads in flooded columns stay still: nobody gets in, nobody gets out.

nero.testo: It moves by itself, one step an hour, and is always on top. You see it coming an hour early.

notteInCorso.corpo: You left a lace half done on the pillow. If you start another one, those hours come undone (the story stays).
notteInCorso.rinuncia: The half-woven lace was left as it was.

giornaliero.pronto: Today's lace is ready. It is the same for everyone.
giornaliero.errore: Today's lace could not be prepared. Try again later.

libero.bloccato: The Free lace opens at the end of day 8 of the story.
libero.semeAiuto: Letters and digits. The first letter sets the size (p, m, g). The same seed gives the same lace, even to a friend.
libero.semeNonValido: A seed can only hold plain letters and digits.

libero.gradiBloccati: Grades open at the end of day 16 of the story.

nodoInPiu.desc: A pair of threads holding a grudge.

neroInPiu.desc: A black thread that moves by itself.

notteCorta.desc: Two hours fewer to get everything done.

comandi.intro: One gesture: drag a bobbin. Everything else works from the keyboard too.

azione.cursore: Move the cursor between pairs of columns (in the Archive, while naming, across all columns)
azione.filo: Put the cursor on the thread in that column
azione.incrociaSinistra: Cross the pair, left thread on top
azione.incrociaDestra: Cross the pair, right thread on top
azione.rovescia: Flip the crossing under the cursor
azione.quiete: Skip the quiet hours (when the pillow offers it)
azione.suggerimento: Ask the lamp for a hint
azione.nome: Pin Ada's name on the thread under the cursor
azione.indietro: Pause, or close the open panel

trascina.come: Drag a bobbin past the middle of the next column
trascina.cosa: Cross: the bobbin you drag goes on top

rilascia.cosa: Change your mind: the bobbin goes back

toccaIncrocio.come: Tap or click a crossing in the current hour
toccaIncrocio.cosa: Flip who is on top and who is below

trascinaFuori.come: Drag a crossing off the row, or press Undo

pressioneLunga.cosa: Character card; in the Archive, choose the name

clicDestro.cosa: Character card, like press and hold

toccaSpillo.come: Tap a pin, a boat, a bead or an hour
toccaSpillo.cosa: A bubble explains who, where, when and what it carries

scorri.come: Drag up and down on the lace, or use the wheel

rigaPassata.cosa: Preview it, and go back to it if you like

appuntaNome.come: Tap a bobbin while pinning your name
appuntaNome.cosa: Ada's name goes on that thread

indietroAndroid.cosa: Close the open panel or open Pause

chi.nero: Black thread: it moves on its own, and crosses over whoever it meets.
chi.stranezzaRiserva: Has a quirk: you will find it while weaving.
chi.passanti: {n, plural, one {And a passer-by, who always gives way.} other {And # passers-by, who always give way.}}
